+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def translate_consent_copy(text: str, target_language: str, source_language: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    system = "Translate identity-provider consent copy accurately, preserving tone, meaning, and security terminology."
+    user = {
+        "text": text,
+        "target_language": target_language,
+        "source_language": source_language,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": system},
+                {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(user, ensure_ascii=False)},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0,
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+    return payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+

+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("text")
+    parser.add_argument("target_language")
+    parser.add_argument("--source-language")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    print(translate_consent_copy(args.text, args.target_language, args.source_language))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_claim(text: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
+        raise ValueError("text must be a non-empty string")
+
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    result = (payload.get("results") or [{}])[0]
+    categories = result.get("categories") or {}
+    category_scores = result.get("category_scores") or {}
+
+    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged"))
+    highest_category = None
+    highest_score = -1.0
+    for category, score in category_scores.items():
+        try:
+            numeric_score = float(score)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+        if numeric_score > highest_score:
+            highest_score = numeric_score
+            highest_category = category
+
+    return {
+        "flagged": flagged,
+        "highest_category": highest_category,
+        "highest_score": highest_score if highest_score >= 0 else None,
+        "categories": categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL,
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+def moderate_claims(texts: List[str], api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(texts, list):
+        raise ValueError("texts must be a list of strings")
+    return [moderate_claim(text, api_key=api_key) for text in texts]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import argparse
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Moderate free-text claims or notes using OpenAI Moderation API")
+    parser.add_argument("text", nargs="*", help="Text to moderate")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    if not args.text:
+        raise SystemExit("Provide one or more text arguments")
+
+    results = moderate_claims(args.text)
+    print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

import base64
import hashlib
import os
import secrets
import sys
import urllib.parse
import webbrowser

import requests


AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT = "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
CLIENT_ID = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID")
CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET")
REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8080/callback")
SCOPE = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_OAUTH_SCOPE", "openid email profile")


def _code_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("utf-8")).digest()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")


def _build_authorization_url(state: str, code_verifier: str) -> str:
    params = {
        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
        "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
        "response_type": "code",
        "scope": SCOPE,
        "state": state,
        "code_challenge": _code_challenge(code_verifier),
        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
        "access_type": "offline",
        "prompt": "consent",
    }
    return f"{AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"


def start_oauth_login() -> str:
    if not CLIENT_ID:
        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is required")
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
    auth_url = _build_authorization_url(state, code_verifier)
    webbrowser.open(auth_url)
    code = input("Enter the authorization code: ").strip()
    token_response = requests.post(
        TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
        data={
            "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
            "client_secret": CLIENT_SECRET,
            "code": code,
            "code_verifier": code_verifier,
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    token_response.raise_for_status()
    return token_response.text


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.stdout.write(start_oauth_login())
    except Exception as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: {exc}\n")
        raise
